items.title: The sign of Entropy Change and Spontaneity of a Process (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: The sign of Entropy Change and Spontaneity of a Process: a main subheading of 6.11.3 Entropy changes in reactions, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 138-138.

blocks.text: Kisi substance ki entropy hamesha positive hoti hai, lekin entropy change positive bhi ho sakti hai aur negative bhi.
Positive entropy change (ΔS° = +ve) spontaneous process ke haq mein hai, lekin is ki guarantee nahi.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke positive ΔS° ka matlab spontaneous process hai. Yeh poora sach nahi: positive ΔS° spontaneity ke haq mein hai magar faisla ΔG = ΔH − TΔS karta hai; process tab spontaneous hai jab ΔG negative ho. Maslan CaCO₃ → CaO + CO₂ ka ΔS° positive hai, phir bhi 298 K par yeh spontaneous nahi.
Negative entropy change (ΔS° = –ve) ka matlab hai molecules zyada ordered ho gaye aur disorder kam hua.
Lekin kuch reactions mein sirf entropy change se spontaneity ka pata nahi chalta, aur ek aur quantity chahiye jise free energy kehte hain.

blocks.prompt: a) In reactions mein entropy change positive hogi ya negative? (i) N₂(g) + 3H₂(g) → 2NH₃(g) (ii) 2HI(g) → H₂(g) + I₂(g)
blocks.explanation: (i) Gas ke 4 moles 2 moles ban jate hain, is liye ΔS negative. (ii) Gas ke 2 moles se 2 moles hi bante hain, is liye ΔS taqreeban zero (thoda positive, kyun ke do alag alag gases banti hain).

blocks.prompt: b) In mein se kaun si changes likely (ghaliban) spontaneous hain? (i) khuli bottle se ammonia ki boo ka kamre mein phailna (ii) –10 °C par pani ka barf banna (iii) 20 °C par ethanol ka bhaap banna (iv) pani ka namak ke saath poori tarah milna (v) room temperature par limestone (CaCO₃) ka tootna
blocks.explanation: Spontaneous: (i), (ii), (iii) (khule container se aahista aahista) aur (iv). (v) spontaneous nahi; limestone room temperature par nahi toot-ta.

items: ΔS positive: solid se liquid/gas bane, products mein zyada moles hon, ya gas molecules barhen (CaCO₃ → CaO + CO₂; 2N₂O₅ → 4NO₂ + O₂).
Positive ΔS spontaneity ke haq mein hai, magar aakhri faisla free energy se hota hai.
